Gain 1 action.'; Shell Insertion says 'Chose' in unmatched-memory and 'Choose' on the card.

PIZZA PARTY is data: `hand` (starting and maximum hand size 3, read by the engine through HeroDef.hand_start / hand_max) and the trigger `pizza_party` of effects/michelangelo.json (draw 1 after attacking or scheming).
